snippet.title: Batman: Vengeance (2002) - GBA Longplay | Full Game Walkthrough | No Commentary
snippet.description:
Batman: Vengeance (2002) for the Game Boy Advance - complete full game longplay with no commentary. Experience the complete handheld superhero adventure based on Batman: The Animated Series in this full gameplay walkthrough.

Originally released in 2002, Batman: Vengeance follows the Dark Knight as he investigates a deadly conspiracy orchestrated by The Joker. Explore Gotham City, battle iconic villains and use Batman's gadgets, combat skills and detective abilities to stop crime and uncover the truth.

The Game Boy Advance version features side-scrolling action designed specifically for handheld play while capturing the atmosphere of the console versions. Face classic Batman enemies including The Joker, Harley Quinn, Mr. Freeze, Poison Ivy and more in this action-packed adventure inspired by the acclaimed animated series.

Batman: Vengeance was released for Game Boy Advance, PlayStation 2, Nintendo GameCube, Xbox and PC (Windows). This longplay features the Game Boy Advance version.

🎮 Game: Batman: Vengeance
📅 Release Year: 2002
🕹️ Platforms: Game Boy Advance, PlayStation 2, Nintendo GameCube, Xbox, PC (Windows)
🦇 Genre: Action / Platformer
🏢 Developer: Ubisoft Montreal (GBA version published by Ubisoft)
🏢 Publisher: Ubisoft
📺 Type: Full Game Longplay | No Commentary
